name.zh: 路克斯以巴哈姆特救援

periods.summary: Lux shields Lisha with his Wyvern, then reveals Bahamut and his identity as the Black Hero to defeat Belbet, the imperial remnant Drag-Knights, and remaining Gargoyle Abyss.
periods.cause: Belbet is about to kill or capture Lisha, and ordinary academy forces cannot overcome the Abyss and remnant army.
periods.process: Lux sacrifices his Wyvern to block Belbet's shot, summons Bahamut, uses Gluttony and Instant Strike to dismantle enemy Drag-Rides, and counters Belbet's Godspeed Control.
periods.outcome: Belbet's army is defeated, Lisha survives, and Lux collapses from Bahamut overuse.
periods.aftermath: Airi, Noct, Krulcifer, and Lisha know pieces of Lux's Black Hero secret; Lux is later formally allowed to remain at the academy.
casualties: remaining Gargoyle Abyss destroyed or disabled
periods.significance: Main revelation of volume 1: Lux is the Black Hero and his true power is Bahamut.
